text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see, it's been a year~! Same 
as always, I see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Cicadas buzzing, waves crashing... It 
really feels like summer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this summer a buono and fun one 
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. All right, I'm gonna give it my all 
this year too~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, another passionate summer training 
camp with Hishi Akebono began this year!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the fireworks festival 
together this year too~!
